name: pulse
description: Pulse - multi-tenant network health monitoring platform

scripts.docker:shell: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec app sh
scripts.docker:install: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm app npm install
scripts.docker:web:install: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm web npm install
scripts.docker:migrate: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm app npm run db:migrate
scripts.docker:generate: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm app npm run db:generate
scripts.docker:lint: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm app npm run lint
scripts.docker:typecheck: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm app npm run typecheck
scripts.docker:build: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm app npm run build
scripts.docker:test: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm app npm test
scripts.docker:test:integration: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm app npm run test:integration
scripts.docker:test:all: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm app npm run test:all
scripts.docker:check: npm run docker:lint && npm run docker:typecheck && npm run docker:test:all
